full_text:
Silver shield

Internal ID: ShieldSilver | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Silver x8 | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The Silver shield is the third round shield. It has equal block power compared to Serpent scale shield and can be used to parry enemy attacks for more.

Notes. • When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
